plan_notes: An attacker host was added as a lab scaffold because the IR did not define one.
Host h1 was placed on the external network as the inferred entry point (basis: initial-access action(s) a1); the source does not state its network placement. Confirm or correct it.
No port is known for service Microsoft Exchange Server (s1); it remains unreachable by default.
No port is known for service PowerShell (s3); it remains unreachable by default.
No port is known for service PSExec (s4); it remains unreachable by default.
Host h1 is not deployed: no deployable service is known for it. Steps that act on it are not reproduced.
No port is known for service Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) (s2); it remains unreachable by default.
Host h2 needs Active Directory Domain Services (unsupported pending fixture) as a VM, which is not deployable yet (not currently reproducible; requires versioned isolated DC/member topology).
